collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-15  -  THE DIFFERENT ANSWER SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: Two young scholars disagree about an unusual mark found on a stone, and their classmates expect one to be declared correct.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two young scholars disagree about an unusual mark found on a stone, and their classmates expect one to be declared correct.

choices.label: Compare the Evidence for Both Explanations.
Ask a Third Scholar to Examine the Stone Independently.
Set the Stone Aside Until Better Evidence Appears.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The scholars discover that neither interpretation accounts for every detail.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Future observers will be able to compare the competing ideas.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The scholars realize they need a clearer description of the original mark.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The new observer notices a feature both scholars overlooked.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The third interpretation differs from both, leaving the question unresolved.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The scholars return to their work without treating uncertainty as failure.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: One scholar remains frustrated but agrees that guessing would not settle the question.

a2__fx.name: Outcome A2
a2__fx.text: A closer examination supports one explanation, and the other scholar accepts the finding.
